tests.report:
Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: Clicked 'Bahn steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' in the 'Ersteinrichtung' dialog (first attempts errored because the continuously re-rendering dialog made element refs stale; a text-based click then succeeded). After waiting 25 seconds the new snapshot still showed the dialog asking to place Bahn 1 on the calibration point with the same confirm button; it never advanced to Bahn 2. One console error was logged.
Steps completed before failure: 4

Feature: A second frontend shows the current setup step
Expected: The second tab directly shows the current step, i.e. the request to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point, not the request for the first train
Observed failure: Opened the app and a second tab at the app URL. The 'Ersteinrichtung' dialog in the second tab (like the first) still asked to place Bahn 1 on the calibration point ('Bitte stellen Sie Bahn 1 auf den Kalibrierpunkt.'); the request for Bahn 2 never appeared - the setup had not advanced past the first train.
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: Completing the setup in one frontend completes it in all frontends
Expected: In both tabs the calibration dialog is gone and the Start button is enabled, and the track graphic shows markers for both 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2'
Observed failure: Opened the app in two tabs; both still showed the 'Ersteinrichtung' dialog asking for Bahn 1, so no confirm button for the second train existed. Clicking the only confirm button 'Bahn steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' in tab 2 had no visible effect - after 25 seconds tab 2 still showed the Bahn 1 prompt. Tab 1 (snapshot and screenshot): calibration dialog still open, Start button disabled, no train markers in the track graphic (only legend entries).
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: Each train is calibrated in its own direction
Expected: The history of 'Bahn 1' contains a low speed greater than 0 with the direction backward, the history of 'Bahn 2' contains the same low speed with the direction forward, and for both trains it is later followed by speed 0
Observed failure: In the mock server console the column 'Applied speed changes (oldest first)' shows only '0 forward' for both Bahn 1 and Bahn 2; no calibration speed > 0 (backward for Bahn 1, forward for Bahn 2) was ever sent. The message log shows only the initial speed 0 commands at app connect.
Steps completed before failure: 1

Feature: After the setup the first train waits at the calibration waiting point and the second stays at the calibration point
Expected: After its calibration speed, the history of 'Bahn 1' contains a higher speed forward and then speed 0; the history of 'Bahn 2' contains only the calibration speed and speed 0; the current speed of both trains is 0
Observed failure: Mock server console: 'Applied speed changes (oldest first)' shows only '0 forward' for both trains, current speed 0. No calibration speed and no drive of Bahn 1 to the calibration waiting point ever occurred; the message log shows only the initial speed 0 command per train.
Steps completed before failure: 2

Feature: Live status of each train
Expected: For each train the app shows that a connection to the train exists ('Verbunden') and shows its current speed (0 while the trains are stopped)
Observed failure: The 'Ersteinrichtung' modal (asking for Bahn 1) overlays the control panel and intercepts clicks on the 'Bahn 1'/'Bahn 2' tabs. Clicking 'Bahn steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' had no effect (dialog still asks for Bahn 1). The default-selected Bahn 1 tab shows 'Verbunden' and 'Geschwindigkeit: 0' (OK), but Bahn 2 could never be selected, so its status and speed were not shown.
Steps completed before failure: 4

Feature: Edit the stops of a train
Expected: The stop selection offers exactly the four stops 'Haltestelle 1' to 'Haltestelle 4'; after removing, exactly 'Haltestelle 1' and 'Haltestelle 3' remain, numbered 1 and 2 in this order
Observed failure: The 'Ersteinrichtung' modal (asking for Bahn 1) covers the page; 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen', 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' and 'Start' are disabled behind it. Clicking 'Bahn steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' twice (waiting 15 s and 30 s) never closed the dialog. Routes could not be reset, no stops could be added, set or removed.
Steps completed before failure: 2

Feature: Any number of stops, the same stop several times, one list per train
Expected: 'Bahn 2' lists all 8 stops without an error or limit message, and its stops 1 and 3 both show 'Haltestelle 4'; 'Bahn 1' has exactly 1 stop, the stops of 'Bahn 2' do not appear in its list
Observed failure: The 'Ersteinrichtung' modal (asking for Bahn 1) covers the page; 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen' and 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' are disabled. Clicking 'Bahn steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' twice had no effect; the dialog stayed open and the buttons stayed disabled. No stops could be added.
Steps completed before failure: 2

Feature: Reset all routes removes all stops
Expected: Both trains have no stops anymore; the stop list shows 'Noch keine Haltestelle gewählt.'
Observed failure: The 'Ersteinrichtung' modal (asking for Bahn 1) stays open; clicking 'Bahn steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' has no effect (still open after 10 s). Its overlay intercepts clicks on the 'Bahn 1' tab; 'Haltestelle hinzufügen', 'Start' and 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen' are disabled. No stops could be added or reset.
Steps completed before failure: 2

Feature: Start without any stop is refused
Expected: The control does not start: the status badge still shows 'Gestoppt' and the Start button is still shown, and the message 'Bitte mindestens eine Haltestelle wählen' appears
Observed failure: The 'Ersteinrichtung' modal (asking for Bahn 1) blocks the page; 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen' and 'Start' are disabled behind it (badge 'Gestoppt'). Clicking 'Bahn steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' twice had no effect; the dialog stayed open and both buttons stayed disabled. Start could not be clicked and the message 'Bitte mindestens eine Haltestelle wählen' never appeared.
Steps completed before failure: 2

Feature: Start locks the editing
Expected: The status badge shows 'In Fahrt', a red Stop button is shown instead of the Start button, the stops cannot be changed, added or removed (instead of 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' there is a disabled button 'Während der Fahrt gesperrt'), and 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen' is disabled
Observed failure: The 'Ersteinrichtung' modal (asking for Bahn 1) covers the UI; 'Haltestelle hinzufügen', 'Start' and 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen' are disabled behind it. Clicking 'Bahn steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' twice had no effect; the dialog never closed. No train could be selected, no stops set and Start could not be clicked.
Steps completed before failure: 1

Feature: Start makes the locomotives drive
Expected: Both histories contain entries with a speed higher than the calibration speed (the train's normal speed) and the direction forward; at least one train currently has a speed greater than 0; apart from the calibration speed, each train uses only one non-zero speed value
Observed failure: The 'Ersteinrichtung' modal (asking for Bahn 1) stays open; clicking 'Bahn steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' twice had no effect. Behind it 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' and 'Start' are disabled, status 'Gestoppt', speed 0, no stops. Stop lists could not be set and Start could not be clicked, so the locomotives never drove.
Steps completed before failure: 2

Feature: Train positions move live in the preview
Expected: At least one train marker is at a clearly different place on the track in the second screenshot
Observed failure: The 'Ersteinrichtung' modal (asking for Bahn 1) stays open; clicking 'Bahn steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' twice had no effect. The modal covers the page, so no train could be selected and no stops set; 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' and 'Start' are disabled. The trains could not be started, so no marker movement could be observed.
Steps completed before failure: 2

Feature: The trains run around the loop in opposite directions
Expected: Comparing consecutive screenshots, the marker of 'Bahn 1' moves clockwise along the main loop and the marker of 'Bahn 2' moves counter-clockwise; the two trains do not circle the loop in the same sense
Observed failure: The 'Ersteinrichtung' modal (asking for Bahn 1) stays open; clicking 'Bahn steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' twice had no effect (still visible after 10 s). 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' and 'Start' are disabled behind it, no stops set. The trains could not be started; no train movement was seen in the track graphic.
Steps completed before failure: 1

Feature: Switches are set while driving
Expected: After Start, new switch changes have been added to the history of 'Weichen', i.e. the app has set switches via the Switch Server while the trains were driving
Observed failure: Mock console showed 'none' under 'Applied switch changes' for 'Weichen'. In the app the 'Ersteinrichtung' modal (asking for Bahn 1) stays open; clicking 'Bahn steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' twice had no effect. 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' and 'Start' stay disabled, no stops set. The trains could not be started, so no switch changes occurred.
Steps completed before failure: 4

Feature: Head-on meeting: one train evades to the siding
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains at least one entry '<train> weicht aus' and, later, an entry '<train> wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis' for the same train
Observed failure: The 'Ersteinrichtung' modal (asking for Bahn 1) stays open; clicking 'Bahn steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' twice had no effect. Its overlay intercepts clicks on 'Bahn 1'; 'Start' is disabled. No stop lists could be set and the trains could not be started; the 'Betriebsprotokoll' shows 'Noch keine Einträge.'
Steps completed before failure: 1

Feature: After a meeting both trains continue (no deadlock)
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains an entry '<train> wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis', later '<train> fährt weiter' for the same train, and after that further entries '… erreicht …' for both 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2'
Observed failure: The 'Ersteinrichtung' modal (asking for Bahn 1) stays open; clicking 'Bahn steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' twice had no effect (still open after > 15 s; the dialog is re-rendered about every second). 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' and 'Start' are disabled. No stop lists could be set and the trains could not be started; the 'Betriebsprotokoll' stays 'Noch keine Einträge.'
Steps completed before failure: 1

Feature: Trains never occupy the same place
Expected: In none of the screenshots do the markers of 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2' overlap or stand on the same track section; one train waits or evades while the other passes
Observed failure: The 'Ersteinrichtung' modal (asking for Bahn 1) stays open; clicking 'Bahn steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' twice had no effect. 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' and 'Start' stay disabled, no stops, badge 'Gestoppt'. Stop lists could not be set and the trains could not be started, so the required behaviour could not be observed.
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: Stops are driven in a loop
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 2', later 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 4' and later again 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 2'
Observed failure: The 'Ersteinrichtung' modal (asking for Bahn 1) stays open; clicking 'Bahn steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' twice had no effect. Its overlay intercepts the click on 'Bahn 1'; 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' and 'Start' are disabled, badge 'Gestoppt'. No stop lists could be set and the trains could not be started; nothing was written to the 'Betriebsprotokoll'.
Steps completed before failure: 1

Feature: Recalibration during operation
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains '<train> wird kalibriert' followed later by '<train> ist kalibriert' for the same train, and the mock history shows normal speed, then the low calibration speed, then normal speed again
Observed failure: The 'Ersteinrichtung' modal (asking for Bahn 1) stays open; clicking 'Bahn steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' twice had no effect. Badge 'Gestoppt', 'Start' and 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' disabled, no stops, 'Betriebsprotokoll' shows 'Noch keine Einträge.' Operation could not be started, so no recalibration could be observed.
Steps completed before failure: 1

Feature: The operation log shows Start and Stop
Expected: After Start the log shows a new entry 'Start', and after Stop the newest entry, at the top of the log, is 'Stop'; every entry shows a time of day
Observed failure: The 'Ersteinrichtung' modal (asking for Bahn 1) stays open; clicking 'Bahn steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' twice had no effect (still open after 10 s). 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' and 'Start' disabled, no stops, badge 'Gestoppt'. Start/Stop could not be clicked; the 'Betriebsprotokoll' only showed 'Noch keine Einträge.'
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: Stop unlocks the editing
Expected: The status badge shows 'Gestoppt', the Start button is shown again, and 'Bahn 1' now has 3 stops
Observed failure: The 'Ersteinrichtung' modal (asking for Bahn 1) stays open; clicking 'Bahn steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' twice had no effect. Its overlay intercepts the click on 'Bahn 1'; 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' and 'Start' are disabled, 'Noch keine Haltestelle gewählt.' No train could be selected, no stops edited, operation could not be started or stopped.
Steps completed before failure: 2

Feature: Stop halts all locomotives
Expected: The speed of both 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2' is 0
Observed failure: The 'Ersteinrichtung' modal (asking for Bahn 1) stays open; clicking 'Bahn steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' twice had no effect. Its overlay intercepts the click on the 'Bahn 1' tab; 'Start' and 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' are disabled. Stop lists could not be configured; Start and Stop could not be clicked, so the required Start/Stop sequence could not be performed.
Steps completed before failure: 1

Feature: Operation can be started again after a Stop
Expected: The log shows, from old to new, 'Start', 'Stop' and 'Start' again, and after the second 'Start' at least one new entry '<train> erreicht <stop>'
Observed failure: The 'Ersteinrichtung' modal (asking for Bahn 1) stays open; clicking 'Bahn steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' twice had no effect (still open after 10 s). Its overlay intercepts the click on 'Bahn 1'. Stops could not be configured, 'Start' stays disabled; the 'Betriebsprotokoll' stays 'Noch keine Einträge.'
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: Unreachable locomotive server: train hidden, disconnected and an error message is shown
Expected: 'Bahn 2' is not shown in the track graphic, its status shows that there is no connection to the train ('Nicht verbunden'), and the page shows an error message that the server 'Bahn 2' cannot be reached
Observed failure: After taking Bahn 2 offline and reloading, the page shows 'Server Bahn 2 kann nicht erreicht werden.' (OK) and no Bahn 2 marker is visible in the track graphic. But the 'Bahn 2' tab cannot be selected: the overlay of the 'Ersteinrichtung' modal intercepts the click, and confirming in the modal has no effect. The status panel only ever showed '● Verbunden / Geschwindigkeit: 0' (Bahn 1); 'Nicht verbunden' for Bahn 2 was never shown.
Steps completed before failure: 8

Feature: Locomotive server becomes reachable again
Expected: The mock console shows at least 1 connected client for 'Bahn 2', and the app shows the connection to 'Bahn 2' again without an error message about 'Bahn 2'
Observed failure: After bringing Bahn 2 back online the mock console shows 'Online', 'Connected clients: 1', and on reload the app no longer shows the Bahn 2 error banner (OK). But 'Bahn 2' could not be selected: the 'Ersteinrichtung' modal overlay intercepts the click and confirming in the modal has no effect. The only visible status '● Verbunden' belongs to the default-selected Bahn 1; the status of Bahn 2 was never shown.
Steps completed before failure: 12
